import pytest
from genty.genty_args import GentyArgs

def test_genty_args_no_args():
    args_instance = GentyArgs()
    assert args_instance._args == ()
    assert args_instance._kwargs == {}

def test_genty_args_only_positional():
    args_instance = GentyArgs(1, 2, 3)
    assert args_instance._args == (1, 2, 3)
    assert args_instance._kwargs == {}

def test_genty_args_only_keyword():
    args_instance = GentyArgs(name="Alice", age=30)
    assert args_instance._args == ()
    assert args_instance._kwargs == {'name': 'Alice', 'age': 30}

def test_genty_args_mixed_positional_and_keyword():
    args_instance = GentyArgs(1, 2, 3, name="Alice", age=30)
    assert args_instance._args == (1, 2, 3)
    assert args_instance._kwargs == {'name': 'Alice', 'age': 30}

def test_genty_args_kwargs_method():
    args_instance = GentyArgs(name="Alice", age=30)
    assert args_instance.kwargs() == {'name': 'Alice', 'age': 30}

def test_genty_args_iteration():
    args_instance = GentyArgs(1, 2, 3, name="Alice", age=30)
    iterated_args = list(args_instance)
    assert iterated_args == [1, 2, 3, 'age=30', 'name=Alice']
